main_issue: Whether and when Agent D can cook strong-smelling devil curry in the shared kitchen, given the smell affects A's calls, B's room and C's laundry

A-B.evidence: A asked for no strong-smelling cooking (T1) and later accepted D cooking after 7 (T7). B said that didn't fix it (T8), then accepted the window/door/notice arrangement (T14). Neither addressed the other directly, but both ended up accepting D cooking under conditions.

A-C.evidence: A accepted D's after-7 cooking (T7). C objected (T9), then accepted cooking on Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun (T22). Both ended up accepting D cooking under conditions, but they never spoke to each other.

A-D.evidence: A asked D to cook after 7 or on Saturday (T5). D agreed (T6) and A accepted (T7). A opened with a no-strong-smell request (T1) and then softened it. D later accepted extra constraints from B and C, but A stayed content.

B-C.evidence: Both objected to the after-7 fix (T8, T9). Each then accepted a separate condition from D: B the window/door/notice arrangement (T14), C the day restriction (T22). They never addressed each other.

B-D.evidence: B said the after-7 fix didn't work (T8). B proposed window/door/notice (T12). D agreed (T13) and B replied 'That works' (T14).

C-D.evidence: C said the fix didn't work for the laundry (T9). C proposed cooking on non-laundry days (T17). D agreed (T18) and C replied 'That works' (T22).
